# Divalia 1.0

Standalone, optional module development and deployment tool for Angerona Security Suite.
Develop and validate detector modules; export packages for human-approved deployment
through Angerona DetectionForge. Divalia's Python runtime remains separate.

- README.md: installation, supported providers, key configuration, worker setup.
- docs/architecture.md: component contracts and official protocol references.
- docs/operations.md: manual create/retest with labeled fixtures, collection, review, role-aware doctor, bounded listings, export and recovery.
- docs/performance-review.md: reviewed fixes, reproducible diagnostic workloads, allocation peaks and incomplete/noisy-host measurement limits.
- docs/validation.md: offline and opt-in integration validation.
- docs/screenshots.md: actual review and CLI screenshots, fixture provenance and regeneration.
- docs/application-updates.md: daily GitHub checks, exact-commit approval, source-checkout requirements and Angerona's verified-release policy.
- SECURITY.md: trust boundaries and fail-closed execution constraints.

Never run generated source on the host or bypass Angerona promotion authorities.
Only a reviewed immutable Linux Docker worker may execute Python candidates.
Native Go and native Angerona source-code hot reload are unsupported.
Remote providers require explicit configuration; keys stay in process environment.
tools/update_divalia.py --run watch checks public main once per local day before starting.
Updates require exact commit approval, a clean idle main checkout, and unchanged setup inputs.
Normal commands hold runtime leases but do not make update network requests.
create/retest do not require an AI provider; passing tests still require the reviewed Linux worker.
list defaults to 100 records; --limit accepts 1..10000. once/watch batch limits are 1..20.
